name: Security Context MCP Server
description: Provides instant access to authoritative security documentation from organizations like OWASP, NIST, and major cloud providers through natural language semantic search. It enables users to retrieve security best practices, frameworks, and vulnerability information directly from a locally cached knowledge base.
